items.title: Consumer Brands and Retail (Portland's Most Distinctive Sector)
items.description: Portland is an extraordinary concentration of athletic, outdoor, and lifestyle consumer brands. Nike (Beaverton HQ): the world's largest athletic brand — AI applications span product design analytics, demand forecasting for global distribution, recommendation engines for Nike's DTC digital commerce, and sports performance analytics. Adidas (Portland North American HQ): AI for product analytics, demand planning, and digital retail personalization for Adidas's North American operations. Columbia Sportswear (Portland HQ): demand forecasting for highly seasonal outdoor products, recommendation engines for functional outdoor gear, and supply chain intelligence for Columbia's global manufacturing network. The outdoor ecosystem: hundreds of Oregon-based outdoor, athletic, and lifestyle brands — Danner, LaCrosse Footwear, Keen, and dozens of DTC outdoor brands — demand forecasting, recommendation, and supply chain AI at scales appropriate to mid-market brands.

sections.title: Oregon's Business Environment and AI Investment
sections.description: Oregon's business environment has specific characteristics relevant to AI investment decisions.

items.title: Oregon Corporate Activity Tax (CAT)
items.description: Oregon's CAT applies to businesses with Oregon commercial activity above thresholds — ClickMasters provides technical AI development services; clients should consult their tax advisors on Oregon CAT implications for software and AI service purchases.
items.label: CAT

items.title: Oregon Data Privacy (SB 619)
items.description: Oregon's Consumer Privacy Act (effective 2024) creates consumer data rights that affect AI applications using Oregon resident personal data — ClickMasters designs AI systems with Oregon's data privacy requirements in mind alongside CCPA for California-resident users.
items.label: Oregon Privacy

items.title: Intel's Oregon Significance
items.description: Intel's decision to invest in Hillsboro as its primary US advanced semiconductor manufacturing location creates technology supply chain AI opportunities for Oregon companies serving the Intel ecosystem — equipment suppliers, materials companies, and logistics providers all benefit from AI that Intel's manufacturing investment validates as economically justified.
items.label: Intel Ecosystem
